notes.title: Ver.2 Developing
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=cMHPmNZ6iNU;full][/previewyoutube]
I am currently developing Ver. 2 of this game with graphics, BGM, game system, etc. substantially reworked for release by the end of 2025.
In addition, new game modes will be added.
*Those who have already purchased this product can use Ver. 2 at no additional cost.

In addition, I will be changing the currently listed operating requirements in order to upgrade this game and make it compatible with Windows® 11.
Saved data and replay data prior to Ver. 2 are not compatible.
I apologize in advance for any inconvenience this may cause.
I will announce further details on the news on this store page and on [url=https://x.com/LynxHelixEngine]X (Twitter)[/url].

notes.title: In regards to the future
notes.notes:
Today I am pleased to announce that I have made a small update to this game.
You can check the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1665820/announcements/detail/3177861894969163217]link[/url] for more information.


I will also be in touch regarding the future of this game.
I would like to update the areas that can be improved, [strike]except for game balance,[/strike] although this is irregular and I have not decided how long I will continue to do so.
This is an immature idea, But I would appreciate your understanding.


Lastly, to those who have purchased this game.

I am very happy and grateful for your interest in a game created by an unknown person like me.
Thank you from the bottom of my heart.

notes.title: Full Version Release Date
notes.notes:
LynxHelixEngine's first shoot'em up game.

[b]"Dormant - Episode Galatea #1 -" [/b]

I am pleased to announce that the full version will be available on Steam on [b]April 2, 2022[/b].

Pricing will remain unchanged from the currently available Early Access version.
Available at the same price as the Early Access version.
Language are also available in Japanese and English.

In addition, a soundtrack for the game will be available on Steam.
Please check it out if you like.

Please wait a little longer for the full version to be released.

notes.title: About the plan to release the full version
notes.notes:
Thank you for your interest in "Dormant - Episode Galatea #1 -".
I would like to make an announcement about the release date of the full version.

I had announced the release date of the full version to be [b]the end of 2021 - early 2022[/b],
however I am currently developing it with a target date of [b]early 2022[/b].

Further information will be posted on this game's store page and on Twitter as soon as the game is nearing completion.
I apologize for the inconvenience, but please wait a little longer until the full version is completed.
